title: layout
description: Where the launcher and dashboard live (notch or a separate window), launcher result style, dashboard tabs and widget grid, side sheet placement and the OSD.

host.title: Host
host.description: Where the launcher opens: grown from the notch or as a centered window.

resultStyle.title: Result style
resultStyle.description: How launcher results are laid out.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Show a preview pane next to the selected launcher result.

compactWhenEmpty.title: Compact when empty
compactWhenEmpty.description: Collapse the launcher to its search field until something is typed.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Dashboard placement, tabs and widget grid.

host.title: Host
host.description: Where the dashboard opens: grown from the notch or as a window.

tabs.title: Dashboard tabs
tabs.description: Order and visibility of the dashboard tabs. Drag the grip or use the arrows; widgets are arranged from the dashboard itself with the pencil button.

x-settings.label: prefs.dashboard.tabs
x-settings.keywords: dashboard tabs order hide show reorder widgets wallpapers metrics rail

cols.title: Cols
cols.description: Columns of the dashboard widget grid.

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: Placed dashboard widgets: [{widget, x, y, w, h}] in grid cells. widget = player | quickControls | calendar | specials | notifications | levels | weather | metricsSummary (modules/widgets/dashboard/widgets/WidgetRegistry.js). Empty or invalid uses the default grid; overlaps are pushed down and compacted. Edited in place from the dashboard (pencil button).

side.title: Side
side.description: Edge the side sheet slides from; auto follows the bar.

osd.title: Osd
osd.description: On-screen display for volume and brightness.

position.title: Position
position.description: Screen edge of the OSD; auto is opposite the bar.
